title: TAP_MAS_Telemetry_Schema
description: Validation schema for the multi-agent translation telemetry log payload, used for long-term asynchronous fine-tuning.

input_source.description: The original raw text block extracted from the source document.

baseline_draft.description: The initial unedited translation text generated by the Phase 1 Translator Agent.

mqm_proofread_logs.description: The strict error payload generated by the Phase 2 Annotator Agent based on explicit linguistic codes.

sub_category_code.description: Standardized abbreviation code mapping to specific linguistic infractions (e.g., SP = spelling, OM = omission).

segment.description: The exact character sequence or phrase from the baseline draft containing the error.

reason.description: A precise, objective explanation stating why the highlighted segment constitutes an error.

target_corrected.description: The finalized translation string. Represents the human override text if hitl_verified is true; otherwise matches the Phase 3 output.

hitl_verified.description: Indicates whether the automated pipeline score fell below the acceptable QE threshold, routing the text to human review.

qe_score.description: The reference-free automated evaluation score generated by MetricX-24 or COMET-QE.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted string capturing the exact system execution completion time.
